subject: SIG evidence & control mapping - Alder Systems RFP
messages:
From: Carl Nguyen <c.nguyen@aldersys.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@aldersys.com
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire and evidence request — Alder Systems RFP

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking Alder Systems' RFP — appreciate the quick turnaround. Attached is our SIG questionnaire (v3) and a short procurement template. For the security review we need the following by end of next week (COB Fri, Apr 30) if possible:

- Control mapping: populate the SIG control columns with where Redwood satisfies or compensates for each control.
- Evidence for key controls: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is OK), ISO 27001 certificate, sample config screenshots, key rotation & KMS proof, and example audit logs for auth events.
- A short narrative for any controls marked as "partial" describing compensating controls.

Can you confirm:
1) Whether you can provide an evidence bundle and a mapping spreadsheet?
2) Preferred upload method (SFTP / secure drive / vendor portal)?
3) Point of contact for any technical deep-dive (we may request a 45-min call to walk logs/telemetry).

I've attached: Alder_SIG_Questionnaire_v3.xlsx and procurement_PO_template.docx. If timeline is tight, let me know the earliest you can turn the mapping around.

Regards,
Carl Nguyen
Security Program Manager
Alder Systems

Attachments: Alder_SIG_Questionnaire_v3.xlsx, procurement_PO_template.docx

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Carl Nguyen <c.nguyen@aldersys.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire and evidence request — Alder Systems RFP

Hi Carl — thanks for sending the questionnaire and the procurement template. We're ready to run this as a short evidence sprint. Proposed approach:

1) Control mapping: we'll return a populated spreadsheet with references to our canonical artifacts (control_map tab + crosswalk).
2) Evidence bundle: we will assemble an initial package containing: SOC 2 Type II (redacted), ISO 27001 cert, a control mapping workbook (redwood_control_map_v1.xlsx), short narrative snippets for partial controls, and a small sample of logs/screenshots packaged as evidence_bundle_initial.zip.
3) Upload: we prefer a secure Drive folder or an SFTP drop. If you provide a link/creds we will push the initial package and follow with incremental uploads.
4) Technical call: we can do a 45-min technical deep dive. Proposed slot: Thu, Apr 28 at 11:00 AM PT. If that works, we'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda (auth telemetry, KMS/key rotation, logging retention).

Quick asks from our side:
- Can you confirm whether screenshots need redaction of customer data? We can provide redaction guidance.
- Who on procurement will sign the PO (contact for commercial handoff)?

I'll coordinate internally — tagging Marissa for legal coordination and Ben for account/procurement. Karthik will be the primary technical lead for any log-level walkthroughs.

We should be able to deliver the initial mapping and evidence package within 3 business days after we receive the secure upload or confirmation of timeline (so aim for Apr 29–May 3 delivery depending on upload cadence).

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_control_map_v1.xlsx

1) We've created a secure upload location and shared a folder with your team. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AlderEvidenceUpload (access granted to redwood.ai domain).
2) Procurement contact is Priya Shah (procurement@aldersys.com) — she'll handle the PO.

We can confirm the technical call for Thu, Apr 28 at 11:00 AM PT. I'll send a calendar invite momentarily.

2) We will produce a second, expanded package with additional logs/redactions and narrative write-ups by Mon, May 10.
3) If you need a signed attestation or DocuSign, here is our standard link: https://www.docusign.com/transaction/ALD-2027-1987 — we can populate and route to Priya.

Marissa and Ben — please confirm legal/commercial steps on PO routing to Priya Shah and if we should prepare an invoice schedule.

Thanks,
